workflow.name: Case closure documentation review
workflow.description: When a case is closed, the AI reads its notes, tasks, IOCs, assets and source alerts, rates how well it is documented and lists the gaps. It then suggests a closure report note (summary, timeline, scope, root cause, actions taken, lessons learned, open items), a clearer case description when the current one falls short, and rewrites of up to three existing notes. An analyst accepts or dismisses each suggestion; nothing is changed until then. The case is reviewed once per closure: later updates of the closed case do not run it again. Needs an AI provider.

trigger_config.condition: data.state and data.state.state_name == 'Closed' and (data.close_date or '')[:10] == (event.timestamp or '')[:10]

config.code:
review = inputs.get('review') if is_dict(inputs.get('review')) else {}
current = str(inputs.get('description') or '').strip()
max_notes = int(inputs.get('max_notes') or 3)

def text(value, size):
    return value.strip()[:size] if is_str(value) else ''

def texts(value, size, count=30):
    items = [text(v, size) for v in value] if is_list(value) else []
    return [v for v in items if v][:count]

def cell(value):
    return text(value, 500).replace('\n', ' ').replace('|', '\\|')

# The assessment, shown above the closure report
assessment = review.get('assessment') if is_dict(review.get('assessment')) else {}
quality = assessment.get('quality') if assessment.get('quality') in ('good', 'fair', 'poor') else 'unknown'
gaps = texts(review.get('gaps'), 500)
lines = [f'**Documentation quality:** {quality}', '']
if text(assessment.get('summary'), 2000):
    lines += [text(assessment.get('summary'), 2000), '']
if gaps:
    lines += ['**Gaps**', ''] + [f'- {g}' for g in gaps] + ['']
assessment_text = '\n'.join(lines).strip()

# The closure report note
report = review.get('closure_report') if is_dict(review.get('closure_report')) else {}
summary = text(report.get('summary'), 5000)
lines = ['## Summary', '', summary, '']
timeline = [e for e in report.get('timeline') or [] if is_dict(e) and cell(e.get('what'))] \
    if is_list(report.get('timeline')) else []
if timeline:
    lines += ['## Timeline', '', '| When | What |', '| --- | --- |']
    lines += [f"| {cell(e.get('when')) or 'Unknown'} | {cell(e.get('what'))} |" for e in timeline[:50]]
    lines.append('')
sections = (('Scope', 'scope', '- '), ('Root cause', 'root_cause', ''), ('Actions taken', 'actions_taken', '- '),
            ('Lessons learned', 'lessons_learned', '- '), ('Open items', 'open_items', '- [ ] '))
for title, key, bullet in sections:
    items = texts(report.get(key), 500) if bullet else [text(report.get(key), 3000)]
    items = [i for i in items if i]
    if items:
        lines += [f'## {title}', ''] + [f'{bullet}{i}' for i in items] + ['']
lines.append('_Drafted by an AI workflow from the case content when the case was closed; review it before accepting._')

# A new description, only when it changes something
description = text(review.get('case_description'), 10000)
if description == current:
    description = ''

# Rewrites of existing notes: full bodies, one per note
notes = []
seen = []
improvements = review.get('note_improvements') if is_list(review.get('note_improvements')) else []
for item in improvements:
    if not is_dict(item):
        continue
    note_id = item.get('note_id')
    if not is_number(note_id) or note_id != int(note_id) or note_id <= 0 or int(note_id) in seen:
        continue
    content = text(item.get('note_content'), 50000)
    if len(content) < 20:
        continue
    seen.append(int(note_id))
    title = text(item.get('note_title'), 155)
    payload = {'note_content': content}
    if title:
        payload['note_title'] = title
    notes.append({'note_identifier': int(note_id), 'payload': payload, 'title': title or f'Note #{int(note_id)}',
                  'reason': text(item.get('reason'), 1000) or 'Clearer and more complete.'})
notes = notes[:max_notes]

result = {
    'quality': quality,
    'gaps': gaps,
    'assessment': assessment_text,
    'report': '\n'.join(lines).strip(),
    'has_report': len(summary) >= 20,
    'description': description,
    'has_description': len(description) >= 20,
    'notes': notes,
    'note_count': len(notes),
    'has_note_1': len(notes) >= 1,
    'has_note_2': len(notes) >= 2,
    'has_note_3': len(notes) >= 3,
}
